name: Chaldea
description: An interactive widget library for Quickshell. Preview, customize, and export native QML for your Linux desktop.

paragraphs: Chaldea is an interactive widget library for Quickshell. Try a design in your browser, adjust its appearance, and export native QML for your Linux desktop.

The collection includes quick notes, media players, animated glyphs, interactive art, and lockscreen layouts. Every current catalog entry has a native QML export. See the inventory for the designs and current counts.
features: Search by name, filter by family, and try widgets in live previews.
Adjust colors, typography, layout, and motion through each widget's available settings.
Copy generated QML or download individual output files, supporting assets, and licenses.
Browse and customize without an account or saved customization state.
The hosted site uses Vercel Web Analytics for visitor and page-view counts. Search text and customization values are excluded. See analytics and privacy.
